visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor restaurant setting where two men are seated at a table with a large hotpot. Behind them, two women in vibrant Sailor Moon cosplay—one with aqua-blue hair and the other with yellow-blonde hair—start dancing energetically. The women smile broadly, wearing stylized white gloves and sailor uniforms, performing coordinated arm swings and poses. (2) As the video progresses through rapid cuts, the men continue to eat calmly, occasionally glancing at each other or the dancers with expressions of mild confusion or resignation. The women increase their energy, jumping and striking iconic anime-style poses while the background reveals a beverage refrigerator and other restaurant patrons. (3) The final sequence shows the women leaning in close to the seated men, pointing and making dramatic gestures directly over their shoulders. The contrast between the men's focused eating and the women's high-arousal performance is highlighted through medium-shot framing and rhythmic visual edits that sync with the background activity.
